description: The template's files under template/ are Jinja, which most managers don't look at or can't parse. The Dockerfile and workflow managers read them line by line, so they only need the file names; the GitLab CI file and pyproject.toml get regex managers. Files without the .jinja suffix (requirements-uv.txt, .pre-commit-config.yaml, renovate.json) are found by the default managers.
